Simple random sample of segments

Source: R/05b_groundtruth_sample.R
pam_recall_sample.Rd

Simple random sample of segments

Usage

pam_recall_sample(frame, n, seed = 1L, exclude_keys = character())

Arguments

frame

Segments from pam_recall_frame().

n

Number of segments.

seed

Random seed.

exclude_keys

seg_keys already drawn; never drawn again.

Value

A data.table of min(n, available) segments.
